text: Answer: none met yet, so WATCH. My ACT_NOW was wrong on my own test. D close_vs_swing_high_pct -1.82 is price back under the broken Creek, and C5 asks price to hold outside the old range without re-entering; with the last D bar red and H1 LH/LL there is no sign-of-strength bar (C12). I stand behind WAIT: a daily close back above the swing high first, then h1_close_above:bar_high as the trigger. Wrong if a daily close under fib_swing_low. Oneil's 1.40 and elder_pattern are not my tests; I do not lean on them.
what_moved_me: Timing ACT_NOW to WAIT on my own C5 test: D close_vs_swing_high_pct -1.82 (re-entered the range under the Creek), last D bar red, H1 LH/LL (no SOS bar, C12).
